relevant_laws.quote: Upon a highway designated and signposted for one-way traffic a vehicle shall be driven only in the direction designated.
notes: Document ordinary driver actual physical control where relevant.
Establish highway status, qualifying vehicle and actual physical control.
Establish qualifying highway and motor-vehicle status.
Establish sign instruction, orientation, authority, placement and governance over the ego route.
Establish sign instruction, orientation, authority, spatial scope and actual vehicle direction of travel.
Retain actual motion and travel direction rather than relying solely on heading.
Retain at least two same-direction vehicle lanes and document one-way designation and signposting over the ego route.
Retain at least two same-direction vehicle lanes and document the one-way designation and its extent.
